object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Only one operator outside a kind's set is tried; the rest of the matrix is a gap.
object.description: In a document with an attribute of each kind, apply lt to an enumeration; and apply eq to an enumeration, contains, starts-with and is-empty to text, ge and between to an integer, lt to a real, is-true and is-false to a boolean, and before, after and between to a date. Expected: lt on the enumeration is refused as not valid; each of the others is applied. The operators Mellon offers include eq for an enumeration, between for an integer and a real, before for a date, is-true for a boolean and starts-with for text, and none for an unknown kind.
